playbookOutputs: Custom Board of Directors and/or Shareholders Resolution (Ordinary or Special) drafted in accordance with the Companies Act 71 of 2008 (PDF)
playbookCommonFailures: Resolution does not include all active directors listed on the CIPC CoR 14.3 / CoR 39 certificate
Transaction requires a Shareholders Special Resolution under s65/s112/s115 of the Companies Act or the company MOI, but only a Board Resolution was prepared
Specific bank/institution wording or authorized signatory ID number is omitted

informationToProvide.label: Company Name & CIPC Registration Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Registered company name and CIPC registration number.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Registered company name and CIPC registration number.

informationToProvide.label: Purpose of the Resolution & Specific Corporate Action / Authorised Signatory Details
informationToProvide.helpText: Describe the exact corporate action to be authorised (e.g., opening/amending a bank account at FNB, appointing a public officer, approving a loan/lease, issuing/transferring shares, CIPC director/address/name change) and who is authorised to sign documents on behalf of the company.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Detailed purpose of the resolution, transaction particulars, and name/ID of the person authorised to execute documents.

informationToProvide.label: Full Names & SA ID / Passport Numbers of All Directors and Shareholders
informationToProvide.helpText: List the full names and ID numbers of all current directors (and shareholders if a shareholders resolution is required).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Full names and ID numbers of all directors and shareholders for the signature blocks.

informationToProvide.label: CIPC Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3 / CoR 39)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the latest CIPC CoR 14.3 or CoR 39 certificate showing all active directors.
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR 14.3 or CoR 39 certificate showing company details and active directors.

informationToProvide.label: Company Memorandum of Incorporation (MOI) (optional)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company MOI if a customised MOI applies.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect CoR 14.3, director/shareholder details and resolution purpose
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Company CoR 14.3, list of directors/shareholders, and specific resolution purpose are on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ensure we have the exact transaction details, authorised signatory name/ID, and the latest CIPC CoR 14.3 showing all active directors.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify Companies Act s60/s65/s74 requirements and active directors on CoR 14.3
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Confirmed whether a Board Resolution (s74), Ordinary Shareholders Resolution, or Special Shareholders Resolution (s65) is required and verified all director names/IDs
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Cross-check all directors against the CoR 14.3. Determine whether the corporate action requires a Board Resolution, Shareholders Resolution, or both under the Companies Act 71 of 2008.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft the Company Resolution PDF
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Custom Company Resolution PDF drafted with full recital, operative clauses, and signature blocks for every director/shareholder
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Draft the formal resolution containing the company header, Companies Act citation, background recitals, specific operative resolutions, authorised signatory mandate, and signature blocks for all directors/shareholders.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver final Company Resolution PDF and signing instructions
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Resolution PDF posted to Communication History with signing and filing guidance
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Deliver the ready-to-sign Company Resolution PDF in Communication History and explain who must sign and how the signed resolution should be retained in the company minute book.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the resolution drafting order is complete
